description: This file defines the PolicyCommand interface, which aggregates all command types related to policies within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes constants, default method implementations, and nested classes for JSON field definitions, serving as a base interface for specific policy command implementations.

classes.name: PolicyCommand
classes.description: An interface that aggregates commands related to policies in the Ditto framework. Extends Command and WithEntityType, providing default method implementations and constants specific to policy commands.

classes.name: PolicyCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested class containing JSON field definitions specific to PolicyCommand, notably the 'policyId' field.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string used for policy commands, combining a static prefix with a type qualifier.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId for this command, identifying the policy entity involved.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Specifies that PolicyCommands only support JsonSchemaVersion.V_2.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, which is the entity type for policies.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets DittoHeaders for the command, returning the command instance.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the EntityType associated with policies, as defined in PolicyConstants.
